Politics · India

Opposition Protests Parliament Over Ram Temple Donations, Student Protests

Opposition Members of Parliament protested in Parliament over allegations of theft of Ram Temple donations and police action against students. Rajya Sabha Chairman blocked Congress leader Kharge from raising the Ram Temple donation issue, calling it a state matter. The Jharkhand government is reportedly wary of the ongoing protests in Ranchi concerning a CBI probe. The Congress party alleged that the BJP is politicizing the Jharkhand students' stir and brought outsiders to disrupt protests. The Lok Sabha Speaker stated it is not right to tarnish the image of the House amid the protests.
